Is Higgsfield worth it?

Higgsfield plan rates we track run from $0.0113/s (Ultra annual, 480p, from a credit plan, checked 2026-11-26, https://higgsfield.ai/pricing) to $0.492/s (Plus monthly, Veo 3.1 720p, estimated from a credit plan, checked 2026-11-26, https://higgsfield.ai/pricing). Both assume every credit you pay for is used. The table sets each plan rate next to the cheapest non-Higgsfield rate for that model.

Is Higgsfield Pro's 1,000 credits enough for Seedance, or should I use Kling instead?

Higgsfield Pro's price and a 1,000-credit allowance are not in our plan data, so the figures below are per 1,000 credits on the plans we do track. At the Kling 3.0 720p credit rate we track (7.5 credits for a 5-second clip, estimated from a credit plan), 1,000 credits is about 133.33 clips, or 666.67 seconds. Seedance 2.5 has no Higgsfield credits-per-clip row, so there is no Seedance second count from 1,000 credits. Higgsfield Seedance 2.5 per-clip credits: The plan page says '~80 Seedance 2.5 videos' for 1,200 credits and does not give clip length or resolution, so there is no dollars-per-second row. Higgsfield Kling 3.0 credits: The compare table says ~7 credits/5s at 720p and the plan quiz says ≈14 credits per 8s 720p. Those two figures disagree, so neither is a dollars-per-second row. The cheapest Kling 3.0 rate outside Higgsfield is $0.0594 per second for Kling 3.0 Pro on Magnific (plan tier Pro (annual), resolution 1080p, audio not stated, input not stated, priced at 5s), from a credit plan (checked 2026-11-22, https://www.magnific.com/pricing). From credit plan. Assumes every credit you pay for is used. The cheapest Seedance 2.5 rate outside Higgsfield is $0.103 per second for non_video_in on Replicate (plan tier not listed, resolution 480p, audio not stated, input not stated, 4–30s), a published rate (checked 2026-11-26, https://replicate.com/bytedance/seedance-2.5). Clip and second counts are 1,000 divided by credits per clip, rounded half up to 2 decimal places. The two rates are the comparison.

Cost of 1,000 credits on each Higgsfield plan we track. That is 1,000 times the plan price divided by its monthly credits.

    Which models have no Higgsfield plan price?

    No Higgsfield plan or API row for Gemini Omni Flash 1.1, Runway Gen-4.x, Grok Imagine Video 1.5. A Higgsfield API row and no Higgsfield plan row for Seedance 2.5. Starter: no row for Veo 3.1. Higgsfield Seedance 2.5 per-clip credits: The plan page says '~80 Seedance 2.5 videos' for 1,200 credits and does not give clip length or resolution, so there is no dollars-per-second row. Higgsfield Kling 3.0 credits: The compare table says ~7 credits/5s at 720p and the plan quiz says ≈14 credits per 8s 720p. Those two figures disagree, so neither is a dollars-per-second row.

    How do we calculate this?

    Each dollar figure is a current price row, with the vendor page and the date that page was checked. A published rate is a dollars-per-second figure on that page, or an API credit count times the credit price the page states. A credit-plan figure is plan price ÷ credits × credits per clip ÷ seconds, and it assumes every credit you pay for is used. When the vendor marks that count with "~", "roughly", or "estimated", the row is labelled estimated from credit plan and is not a list price. A promo shows its end date when the vendor gave one. The full method is on the about page.
